title: Continuum Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.20586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Continuum Attention (CA), a causal Transformer attention operator that replaces discrete key and value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve. Each query induces an exponential relevance density along the curve. Integrating the density and interpolated values yields exact normalized attention from closed form exponential moments, including half token boundary contributions. The gradients follow analytically from moments of order at most two, enabling parallel GPU implementations while retaining quadratic sequence complexity and the standard Transformer decoder. Compared with ordinary softmax and focal attention, CA reduces mean validation negative log likelihood by 0.0200 and 0.0480 nats per byte, respectively, winning all paired comparisons. An additional disjoint validation slice yields a 0.0457 nats per byte advantage over the strongest selected softmax baseline, with a paired 95% confide

translated_abstract: 我们提出了连续注意力，这是一种因果Transformer注意力算子，它用对连续分段线性记忆曲线的积分取代了离散的键值查找。每个查询沿该曲线诱导出一个指数形式的相关性密度。通过对该密度与插值后的值进行积分，可以从闭式指数矩（包括半个token的边界贡献）得到精确的归一化注意力。其梯度可从至多二阶矩解析地推导出来，从而支持并行GPU实现，同时保持二次序列复杂度和标准的Transformer解码器结构。与普通softmax注意力和焦点注意力相比，CA分别将平均验证负对数似然降低了每字节0.0200和0.0480奈特，并在所有配对比较中获胜。在一个额外的不相交验证切片上，CA相比最强选定的softmax基线取得了每字节0.0457奈特的优势，且具有配对95%置信（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出“连续注意力”算子，用对连续分段线性记忆曲线的积分取代离散键值查找，通过闭式指数矩实现精确归一化注意力，在语言建模上以负对数似然显著优于softmax和焦点注意力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Continuum Attention, which replaces discrete key-value lookup with integration over a continuous piecewise-linear memory curve, yielding exact normalized attention via closed-form exponential moments and significantly outperforming softmax and focal attention in language modeling.
